section.46: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

46.name_native: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Saeed bin AL-Musayyab that:a woman from Banu Makhzum borrowed some jewelry, asking on behalf of others, then she denied (having done) that, and the Prophet ordered that her hand be cut off
